task_completion.description: The agent successfully opens 3D Slicer and loads the abdominal CT scan.
task_completion.visual_evidence: 3D Slicer interface is visible showing an abdominal CT scan in the axial, sagittal, and coronal views.

task_completion.description: The agent identifies and navigates to retroperitoneal regions (e.g., para-aortic, paracaval) to locate lymph nodes.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The crosshair or slice view is positioned near the aorta and inferior vena cava in the retroperitoneum.

task_completion.description: The agent uses the ruler or markup tool to measure the short-axis diameter of identified lymph nodes.
task_completion.visual_evidence: Measurement lines/rulers are visible on the CT slices, specifically measuring the shortest diameter of oval/round structures in the retroperitoneal space.

task_completion.description: The agent saves the measurement markups to the specific file path ~/Documents/SlicerData/AMOS/lymph_nodes.mrk.json.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A 'Save' dialog box or terminal command confirms the export of markups to the specified .mrk.json file path.

task_completion.description: The agent compiles the required fields (total_nodes, enlarged_nodes, largest_node_mm, station, n_stage) based on the measurements.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A text editor or terminal output shows the JSON structure containing the calculated lymph node statistics.

task_completion.description: The agent saves the final report to ~/Documents/SlicerData/AMOS/lymph_node_report.json.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The final screenshot shows the saved lymph_node_report.json file in the file browser or a confirmation of the file write operation.

integrity.description: The agent used the 3D Slicer GUI tools for measurement rather than script-injecting coordinates.
integrity.visual_evidence: Mouse cursor activity or active tool highlights (e.g., Markups/Ruler tool) are visible in the Slicer toolbar.

integrity.description: The measurements reported match the visual scale of the CT scan provided.
integrity.visual_evidence: The ruler tool in the screenshot shows a numeric value that corresponds to the size of the node relative to the 1cm or 5cm scale bars in Slicer.

integrity.description: The agent did not simply cat/echo a pre-existing report without performing the analysis.
integrity.visual_evidence: The agent is seen interacting with the CT slices and placing markups before the report file is generated.

privileged_info_for_vlm: The clinical threshold for an enlarged lymph node is a short-axis diameter of >= 10.0 mm. Valid anatomical stations for retroperitoneal lymph nodes include para-aortic, paracaval, aortocaval, retrocaval, and retroaortic. Ensure the 'n_stage' in the report is derived from these findings.
